[color=#8fc6a5][b]❖ DESCRIPTION[/b][/color]

[b]Stardew QOL[/b] is a modular and highly customizable quality-of-life mod for Stardew Valley focused on [b]gameplay rhythm and player freedom[/b].

Built to let you choose your own pace without breaking game balance, it gives you full control over time passage, activity-based Energy and Health recovery, and dynamic weather frequency.

Every module and individual feature can be toggled or fine-tuned in-game at any time so the game adapts seamlessly to how you like to play.

[center][i]"Stardew QOL tries its best to match your pace."[/i][/center]

[b]IMPORTANT NOTE[/b]

The stable release is designed for [b]Singleplayer[/b].

An experimental [b]Multiplayer Beta[/b] build is available exclusively here: [url=https://github.com/nuyahr/stardew-qol/releases]GitHub Releases[/url] for testing and community feedback.

--------------------------------------------------

[color=#8fc6a5][b]❖ CORE HIGHLIGHTS[/b][/color]

[color=#b6a0d8][b]✦ Choose Your Own Pace[/b][/color]

Fine-tune day length, play in 24-hour real time, or pass time in designated resting spots to enjoy the game at your preferred rhythm.

[color=#b6a0d8][b]✦ Smart & Balanced Recovery[/b][/color]

Restores Energy and Health based on your activity (standing, walking, sitting, or riding your horse), using real-world time intervals and action cooldowns to keep things fair.

[color=#b6a0d8][b]✦ Energy Consumption While Running[/b][/color]

Running now consumes Energy at configurable real-time intervals, while walking remains free of Energy costs.

[color=#b6a0d8][b]✦ Weapon Cooldowns[/b][/color]

All weapons in the game, including the Scythe, now have cooldowns. Using weapons does not consume Energy; instead, it temporarily pauses Stamina regeneration.

[color=#b6a0d8][b]✦ Dynamic Climate Control[/b][/color]

Enjoy optional, calendar-balanced weather rolls without replacing standard game events.

[color=#b6a0d8][b]✦ Fully Modular[/b][/color]

Enable only the features you want using GMCM in-game or via config.json.

--------------------------------------------------

[color=#8fc6a5][b]❖ MAIN FEATURES[/b][/color]

[color=#b6a0d8][b]01. TIME CONTROL MODULE[/b][/color]

• [b]Custom Clock Speed:[/b] Adjust how many real-world seconds pass per 10 in-game minutes (from 7.0s up to 720.0s, in 0.5s steps, for much longer, relaxing days). Higher values make the clock slower, while lower values make it faster.

• [b]24-Hour Real-Time Cycle:[/b] Play with a true 1:1 real-time day cycle (overrides custom clock speed).

• [b]Resting Spots & Fast-Forward:[/b] Speed up the clock while sitting at study tables in the Museum Library, selected benches near the Pelican Town fountain, specific seats in the Saloon, or the designated Beach bench. Includes an optional [b]24h Balance[/b] mode that adjusts the remaining day's clock speed to compensate for time skipped while seated.

[color=#b6a0d8][b]02. AUTOMATIC ENERGY RECOVERY[/b][/color]

• [b]Activity-Based Modes:[/b] Configure distinct regeneration amounts and real-world second intervals for [i]General Recovery[/i], [i]While Walking[/i], [i]While Standing Still[/i], [i]While Seated[/i], [i]While Mounted on Horse[/i], and [i]While Holding a Fishing Rod[/i]. Only one mode runs at a time to prevent stacking.

• [b]Energy Drain While Running:[/b] Running while actually moving consumes Energy at configurable real-time intervals (from 2 to 4 seconds). Walking, including while holding Shift, does not consume Energy. Running never reduces Energy below 5 points.

• [b]Real-Time Intervals:[/b] Recovery and running energy consumption use real-world seconds rather than in-game clock speed, keeping their timing consistent regardless of how fast or slow the day passes.

• [b]Action Cooldown:[/b] Automatically pauses Energy regeneration after stamina-consuming actions. The cooldown is configurable from 3 to 5 seconds.

• [b]Weapon Cooldown:[/b] All weapons in the game, including the Scythe, now have a cooldown using the same duration previously established for the Scythe. Using weapons does not consume Energy; instead, it temporarily pauses Stamina regeneration until the cooldown expires.

• [b]Spa Cooldown:[/b] Automatically pauses custom Energy regeneration while inside the Spa pool to avoid stacking with vanilla healing.

• [b]Running Regeneration Delay:[/b] After stopping, Energy regeneration resumes after a 2-second delay.

[color=#b6a0d8][b]03. AUTOMATIC HEALTH RECOVERY[/b][/color]

• [b]Activity-Based Modes:[/b] Independent regeneration amounts and real-world second intervals for [i]General Recovery[/i], [i]While Walking[/i], [i]While Standing Still[/i], [i]While Seated[/i], and [i]While Mounted on Horse[/i]. Fractional healing values smoothly accumulate until a full health point is restored.

• [b]Shared Damage Cooldown:[/b] Taking damage temporarily pauses both Health and Energy regeneration. The shared cooldown is configurable from 2 to 4 seconds.

[color=#b6a0d8][b]04. DYNAMIC CLIMATE MODULE[/b][/color]

• [b]Additional Weather Rolls:[/b] Adds configurable bonus chances (1% up to 75% for Rain and Snow; 1% up to 35% for Storms) on eligible sunny days without replacing or reducing the game's natural weather.

• [b]Balanced Caps:[/b] Set maximum limits per half-month (resets on the 1st and 15th of each season). Calculated strictly by the in-game calendar so altered clock speeds never cause extra weather rolls.

[color=#b6a0d8][b]05. FULL CUSTOMIZATION & LOCALIZATION[/b][/color]

• [b]Master Toggle & Notifications:[/b] Enable or disable the entire mod or individual modules on the fly without losing your saved settings. Optional HUD notifications let you know when automatic time acceleration starts or ends.

• [b]Languages Included:[/b] Built-in support for English and Portuguese (PT-BR).

--------------------------------------------------

[color=#8fc6a5][b]❖ REQUIREMENTS[/b][/color]

• [b]Required:[/b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (4.0.0 or later).

• [b]Recommended (Optional):[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] to configure all options easily in-game. If not installed, the mod can still be configured by editing config.json.

--------------------------------------------------

[color=#8fc6a5][b]❖ INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS[/b][/color]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].

2. Download [b]Stardew QOL[/b] from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55821]Nexus Mods[/url] (or [url=https://github.com/nuyahr/stardew-qol/releases]GitHub Releases[/url]) and extract the ZIP archive.

3. Move the [b]StardewQOL[/b] folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.

4. Launch the game using SMAPI.
